repos.description: Multi-platform auto-proxy client, supporting Sing-box, X-ray, TUIC, Hysteria, Reality, Trojan, SSH etc. It’s an open-source, secure and ad-free.
repos.summary_zh: Hiddify 是一款跨平台代理客户端，基于 Sing-box 构建，支持 Vless、Vmess、Reality、TUIC、Hysteria、WireGuard、SSH 等多种协议。具备自动节点选择、TUN 模式、远程配置同步等功能，界面简洁、无广告、开源安全，支持多语言及深色/浅色主题，适用于 Android、iOS、Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。
repos.summary_en: Hiddify is a multi-platform proxy client built on Sing-box, supporting Vless, Vmess, Reality, TUIC, Hysteria, WireGuard, SSH, and more. It features automatic node selection, TUN mode, remote configuration sync, and an intuitive UI. Open-source, ad-free, and secure, it's available on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.

repos.description: JumpServer is an Open-source Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform with AI-powered capabilities, providing DevOps and IT teams a unified workspace to securely access SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, databases, websites, RemoteApp, VirtualApp, and more.
repos.summary_zh: JumpServer 是一款开源的堡垒机（PAM）平台，为 DevOps 和 IT 团队提供通过浏览器安全访问 SSH、RDP、Kubernetes、数据库及远程应用端点的能力，支持权限管理、会话审计与自动化运维，具备完善的 RBAC 权限控制与多协议支持。
repos.summary_en: JumpServer is an open-source Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform enabling secure, on-demand access to SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, databases, and RemoteApp endpoints via a web browser, featuring comprehensive auditing, RBAC, and multi-protocol support for DevOps and IT teams.

repos.description: One Remote Access Manager to Rule Them All
repos.summary_zh: 1Remote 是一款现代化的个人远程会话管理与启动工具，支持 RDP、SSH、VNC、Telnet、(S)FTP 等多种协议，提供多屏幕 HiDPI 连接、标签化界面、自定义运行器及 mRemoteNG 导入功能，支持便携运行与多语言主题定制。
repos.summary_en: 1Remote is a modern personal remote session manager and launcher supporting RDP, SSH, VNC, Telnet, (S)FTP, RemoteApp, NoMachine and more. It offers multi-screen HiDPI RDP support, customizable runners, mRemoteNG import, portable deployment, and a tabbed, multi-language interface.

repos.description: lanproxy是一个将局域网个人电脑、服务器代理到公网的内网穿透工具，支持tcp流量转发，可支持任何tcp上层协议（访问内网网站、本地支付接口调试、ssh访问、远程桌面、http代理、https代理、socks5代理...）。技术交流QQ群 736294209
repos.summary_zh: lanproxy 是一款高性能内网穿透工具，支持 TCP 流量转发，可代理访问内网网站、SSH、远程桌面等任何 TCP 上层协议。提供 Java 客户端和跨平台 Go 客户端，支持 SSL 加密、多用户管理、自定义域名绑定及 HTTPS 证书自动申请，解决公网访问内网服务的安全与便捷问题。
repos.summary_en: Lanproxy is a high-performance intranet penetration tool that supports TCP traffic forwarding for any TCP-based protocol (e.g., web access, SSH, remote desktop). It offers Java and cross-platform Go clients, with SSL encryption, multi-user support, custom domain binding, and automatic HTTPS certificate issuance, enabling secure and easy public access to private networks.

repos.summary_zh: litter 是一个原生 iOS 和 Android 客户端，专为 Codex 设计，支持跨平台连接 Mac 设备并通过 SSH 访问 Codex 会话。项目采用 Rust 编写核心模块，使用 UniFFI 实现移动端与 Rust 的桥接，集成音频处理（AEC）和网络发现功能（Bonjour/Tailscale），提供高对比度、无障碍友好的 UI 界面。
repos.summary_en: Litter is a native iOS and Android client for Codex, enabling cross-platform access to Mac-based Codex sessions via SSH. Built with Rust for core logic and UniFFI for mobile bridging, it includes audio processing (AEC), network discovery (Bonjour/Tailscale), and supports accessibility features like high contrast and large text modes.

repos.description: Team IDE 集成MySql、Oracle、金仓、达梦、神通等数据库、SSH、FTP、Redis、Zookeeper、Kafka、Elasticsearch、Mongodb、小工具等管理工具
repos.summary_zh: Team IDE 是一款集成多种数据库（MySQL、Oracle、金仓等）、中间件（Redis、Kafka、Elasticsearch等）及开发工具的跨平台IDE。支持SSH终端、数据库可视化操作、SQL执行、Thrift服务测试、JSON/YAML转换等，提供终端透传、SSH隧道、节点管理等高级功能，支持单机和服务器部署。
repos.summary_en: Team IDE is a cross-platform integrated development environment featuring support for multiple databases (MySQL, Oracle, Kingbase, etc.), middleware (Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch), and development tools. It offers SSH terminal, database visualization, SQL execution, Thrift service testing, and JSON/YAML conversion, with advanced features like terminal passthrough, SSH tunneling, and node management. Supports both standalone and server deployment modes.

repos.description: Nothing, just a simple ssh tool.
repos.summary_zh: mmh 是一个轻量级 SSH 管理工具，提供便捷的远程主机连接与命令执行功能，适合运维场景下的快速访问。支持配置管理与批量操作，界面简洁，适合日常使用。
repos.summary_en: mmh is a lightweight SSH management tool designed for quick remote host access and command execution. It supports configuration management and batch operations, featuring a simple interface ideal for routine system administration tasks.
